name: Lucidspark
description: Lucidspark is Lucid's collaborative online whiteboard for brainstorming, workshops, agile planning, research, and visual teamwork. Teams use an infinite canvas of sticky notes, shapes, drawings, comments, voting, and other visual material to explore ideas and organize decisions together.
agentUseSummary: Connect a Lucid account once, then let agents find and read Lucidspark boards, inspect board content and discussions, create or organize boards and folders, manage collaborators and share links, and post comments under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read boards and discussions
capabilities.description: Search and inspect Lucidspark board metadata, structured canvas content, exports, comment threads, comments, collaborators, and share links.

capabilities.label: Create and organize boards
capabilities.description: Create, copy, rename, move, classify, and trash Lucidspark boards using Lucid's documented REST API.

capabilities.label: Manage board collaboration
capabilities.description: Post comments and create, update, or remove user, team, and share-link access for Lucidspark boards.

capabilities.label: Organize folders
capabilities.description: Search, create, rename, move, trash, restore, and inspect folders used to organize Lucidspark boards.

allowed.label: Read Lucidspark boards
allowed.description: Use any supported read-only Lucid REST operation for Lucidspark boards, discussions, collaborators, share links, folders, and the connected profile.

approvalRequired.label: Change Lucidspark boards or access
approvalRequired.description: Create, copy, rename, move, classify, trash, comment on, share, or reorganize Lucidspark resources; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Board, discussion, collaborator, sharing, folder, and profile reads run directly; every creation, content import, comment, organization, sharing, access, or deletion mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized Lucidspark REST operation runs without Relay per-action approval; fixed Lucid origins, exact route allowlists, product binding, request bounds, audits, redaction, provider permissions, plan limits, and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts exact Lucidspark REST wrappers and attaches the user's Lucid OAuth token without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts exact Lucidspark REST wrappers and attaches the user's Lucid OAuth token without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's published Lucid OAuth application, exact Lucidspark callback, four scopes, and Railway client credentials have not yet been configured and verified in a signed-in eligible Lucid developer account.
providerSetup.nextAction: A licensed Team or Enterprise Lucid developer creates and publishes Relay Console, adds the exact production callback and four scopes, stores the Lucid client ID and secret in Railway, then runs OAuth, refresh rotation, bounded board read, Safe mutation denial, approved or Dangerous mutation, upstream revocation, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: Lucid documents a developer-owned confidential authorization-code client, registered redirect URI, licensed developer-account requirement, collaborator-only unpublished apps, and publishing for general distribution; Lucid explicitly says not to ask end users for client credentials.
Lucid documents browser authorization, a five-minute authorization code, JSON token exchange at api.lucid.co, one-hour access tokens, and returned refresh tokens.
Lucid documents offline_access, rotating access and refresh tokens, 180-day unused refresh-token expiry, and invalidation of the previous token pair on refresh.
Lucid documents product-specific Lucidspark content and sharing scopes, folder access, profile access, and offline access; the broad product-content scope includes its child permissions.

Lucid's current REST reference documents Lucidspark search, metadata, structured contents, image export, creation, copy, Standard Import creation, rename, move, classification, trash, discussion, sharing, and collaborator operations.
Lucid documents folder search, inspection, content listing, creation, update, trash, restore, and app-folder operations for organizing documents.
